selection: Whole v0.4.6 glyph half of fnd-sheet-motion-and-glyph: AppPrimitiveThemeDefaults (adds appIconGlyphTextStyle), the three new design-system widgets AppNumberPicker, AppDurationPicker and AppFloatingToolbar, and the v0.4.6 AppWindowActionMenu.
purpose: Replaces the vendored v0.2.5 direct-mode copies of AppPrimitiveThemeDefaults and AppWindowActionMenu (the Sync copies are excluded in prepareUpstreamSources) and adds the three widgets the pinned tree lacks. AppFloatingToolbar is imported by eight carried favorite, watch-later and tab-role archives, so it closes the symbol gate gap that was assigned to this slice. The files are emitted by the existing dynamic-detail-container producer, next to the v0.4.6 AppSheetComponents. No call sites are added.

windowsAdaptations.AppPrimitiveThemeDefaults.kt: appIconGlyphTextStyle returns the shared app text style without the Android-only PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false) copy, and the PlatformTextStyle import is dropped; the Skia JVM text renderer has no font-padding option (desktop PlatformTextStyle has no includeFontPadding constructor). Every other byte is the v0.4.6 file.

outOfScope: AdaptiveBottomSheetPolicyTest reads Android source paths and asserts a View-tree call the Windows sheet removes, so it is not emitted. AppSheetComponents itself is the separate v046-sheet-motion archive.
